*One merge-blocking finding* in `dedupe-imports` against `main`:

*P1 — Dedupe uses object identity instead of contact ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`new Set(contacts)` only removes repeated references to the same object. Separate imports produce different objects for the same contact, so `mergeImports` leaves overlapping contacts duplicated, contrary to the README’s contract.

Reproduced with:
```js
mergeImports(
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }],
  [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }]
)
```
This returns both contacts; it should return only the first.

*Suggested fix:* track seen IDs while filtering in input order. Add a regression test using distinct objects with the same ID, asserting that the first object is retained, plus an overlapping-lists test for `mergeImports`.

All 4 existing tests pass, but they miss this case: the duplicate test repeats the *same object*. No other findings. No files changed.
